scope: first-year contribution, exposure-matched replacement surplus and utility; no eight-year or market-value adoption
conditional: Saved role-display lines and starter sidecar; preserve talent rates; separate SV/HLD and appearance-based QA3. No probability, medical, aging-workload or team discount after substitution.
expected_method: Reuse the preserved strong-prior benchmark unconditional workload: F*(W_benchmark/F), bounded only by existing 754 PA / 251 IP physical limits. Ratio may exceed one when role changes support higher opportunity. No extra absence multiplier. This reexpression is not a newly fitted or improved workload estimate.
historical: Join repaired forecast-date full-role components to original chronological cases by MLBAM ID and anchor. Never construct historical scenarios from current display sidecars. Use saved forecast-date category baselines as fixed talent source. Exclude 2026 outcome records from category evaluation when verified complete category sources are unavailable; show workload separately.
historical_relief: Pure-relief latest prior GS=0 required; estimate IP/RA and SV/HLD per RA from prior observations only. Missing event evidence stays unavailable; do not silently substitute zero. For standalone statistical scoring require complete categories.
catchers: Use historical catcher identity only if dated forecast-year positional evidence exists. Do not backfill current catcher eligibility into historical roles. Otherwise historical catcher accuracy is unavailable; current catcher sensitivity is separately reported.
routes: Preserve prospects/hybrids, unsupported players, swingmen and two-way assets. Current contribution table may show an MLB component for context but do not replace those asset routes.
acceptance: Expected method must improve matched workload MAE and RMSE versus production in both H and P, with no role slice MAE/RMSE worsening more than 5 percent; improvement is exploratory only. Conditional scenarios are judged on high-usage retained-role proxies separately and are not expected-season predictions. No new independent holdout claim.
known_limits: annual high usage is not medical availability
weekly lineup marginal value not evaluated
